label: prf:spectral-sequence-collapse
title: Proof of spectral sequence collapse
html:
Proof. Proof of spectral sequence collapse

Proof. Whitehead's lemma for semisimple algebras over a field of characteristic zero: every Hochschild cocycle in degree k \geq 1 is a coboundary, so \mathrm{HH}^k = 0. Over a commutative ring R the same conclusion holds whenever A is separable / semisimple. The spectral sequence E_r^{p, q} \Rightarrow \mathrm{HH}^{p+q} then has only E_\infty^{p, 0} surviving with p + 0 = 0, giving E_\infty^{0, 0} = \mathrm{HH}^0 = Z(A). \square

Corollary (mass functional is a q-deformed Wedderburn-weighted centre projection). The categorical mass functional pairs the Frobenius integral \int_A : A \to R with the centre via the Wedderburn decomposition (categorical mass, Markov):

  \mathfrak{m}_{q,\mathcal{K}}
  \;=\; \sum_{\lambda \,\vdash\, n} w_\lambda(q) \cdot \frac{\chi_\lambda(\rho(\beta_\mathcal{K}))}{\dim_q V_\lambda},
  \qquad w_\lambda(q) = \frac{\dim_q^2 V_\lambda}{[n]_q!},

The q-deformed Wedderburn weights w_\lambda(q) are bounded, but \sum w_\lambda(q) \neq 1 at q \neq 1 in general (cf. prop:plancherel-weight-boundedness for the classical Plancherel measure w_\lambda(1) = (\dim V_\lambda)^2/n! that does sum to 1). Binning by GB-depth (curvature-rank stratification) gives the curvature-rank decomposition \mathfrak{m}_{q,\mathcal{K}} = \sum_k \alpha_k \cdot \mathfrak{m}^{(k)}_{q,\mathcal{K}}(1) (unified mass formula).

Frobenius duality of strata. The Frobenius pairing \langle a, b \rangle = \int_A a \cdot b gives a self-duality A \cong A^{\vee} (Yekutieli rigidity). Under this duality the GB filtration J^0 \supset J^1 \supset \cdots \supset J^N maps to its annihilator filtration

  (J^\ell)^\perp \;=\; \{a : {\textstyle\int_A}\, a \cdot J^\ell = 0\} \;=\; J^{N - \ell}.

This is Poincaré duality of curvature-rank strata: rank-\ell contributions pair with rank-(N - \ell) contributions under the Frobenius integral. The chirality stratum (S-anti-invariant rank \geq 2) is self-dual under combined S-reversal and rank inversion.

Refuted on the centre, scope (b). The sentence above transports the annihilator duality from A to the strata, and the paragraph below reads those strata off the central idempotents e_\lambda. On that basis the pairing is diagonal, not anti-diagonal, so distinct strata pair to zero: for any linear functional \varphi, \varphi(e_\lambda e_\mu) = \varphi(\delta_{\lambda\mu} e_\lambda). Measured exactly in \mathbb{Q}(q) at n = 3 on the corpus's own idempotents — all six off-diagonal entries identically 0, diagonal \mathrm{diag}(\tau(e_\lambda)) nonzero, completeness self-test \sum_\lambda \tau(e_\lambda) = 1 (centre_frobenius_pairing_is_diagonal_probe.py). So each stratum is self-dual and the annihilator of a stratum within Z is the span of the complementary idempotents — a set complement, not a rank-reindexed stratum. The asserted pairing is identically zero exactly where it claims to be perfect, whenever \ell \neq N - \ell.

Scope (b) rests on a proved invariant — mutual annihilation of distinct central primitive idempotents — which holds for every linear functional and every n. So no choice of filtration and no choice of Frobenius form restores a cross-stratum pairing here, and supplying the missing J^\bullet bridge would not repair it: this defect is independent of the Gap note below.

Not refuted: (J^\ell)^\perp = J^{N - \ell} as a statement about the filtration of A itself, which is a different claim and is untouched here; and the Practical consequence below, which uses the Wedderburn sum and not this duality. Same defect as prf:quantum-dilogarithm-stratified Step 1 (bean qou-xsv8); analysis in docs/audits/2026-08-26-frobenius-duality-of-strata-is-diagonal.md.

Practical consequence. categorical derivation steps need only enumerate central idempotents e_\lambda, compute their GB-depth, evaluate \chi_\lambda via Hoefsmit seminormal form (Hoefsmit pipeline), and sum \sum_\lambda w_\lambda \cdot \chi_\lambda(\beta) / \dim_q V_\lambda binning by \mathrm{depth}(\lambda). No higher-page differentials d_r (r \geq 1) need ever be computed — they all vanish.

Gap. The step above reads a grading of the centre by partition depth off a proposition that stratifies H_n(R,q) by the curvature rank of words. That identification is not stated in the cited proposition, and the three readings of J^\bullet present in the corpus are each excluded: the ideal-power reading is provably \bot above degree 0 (QOU.BraidKnot.WordFiltration.map_pow_eq_bot); the Coxeter-length reading fails a dimension count at n \leq 3; and the rewrite-depth reading is identically zero once def:hecke-normal-form fixes T_w as the unique normal-form basis indexed by S_n. Analysis: docs/audits/2026-08-16-three-gb-filtrations-one-name.md. Not claimed: that this block's conclusion is false — only that the step it rests on is unestablished, and that the obvious ways to establish it do not work.
